info.title: E-Waste Saathi API — Collector
info.description:
Informal e-waste collectors using the mobile app. Flow: check today's price → create a lot → confirm (broadcast to recyclers within 5 km) → see interested recyclers → select one → pay via QR. Also ledger, pickup requests and offline sync.

**Conventions** — money is integer **paise**, weight is integer **grams**, timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.

Success: `{ "data": ... }` · Failure: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`.

**Auth** — mobile clients send `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (from `POST /api/v1/auth/login`); the web portal uses the `ewaste_session` cookie.

Endpoints marked `x-roles` containing `PUBLIC` need no sign-in; the rest require the **COLLECTOR** role.

post.summary: Self-register a new collector
post.description: Creates a `COLLECTOR` user + profile with minimal PII (phone, 4-digit PIN, language, area, consent) and returns a 30-day JWT.

post.summary: Collector sign-in with phone + 4-digit PIN
post.description: Collectors use a PIN here; recycler staff and admins sign in with a password via `POST /api/v1/auth/staff-login`. The JWT carries the user's `role`. Locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.

post.summary: OTP-free PIN recovery (collectors)
post.description: Verifies phone + collector `shortCode` + operating area, then sets a new PIN, clears the lockout and returns a fresh token.

post.summary: Restore a collector session on a new device
post.description: Returns the profile plus `lotCounter` so the app can resume offline lot numbering.

get.description: `collector` is set for collectors, `recycler` for recycler staff; both are `null` otherwise. The flat collector fields are kept for older app builds.

post.summary: Change the signed-in collector's PIN

get.summary: Full reference snapshot for the mobile cache
get.description: Categories, safety topics, recent prices (max 200), VERIFIED recyclers + current rates, collection points and area centroids.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only return prices recorded after this ISO timestamp

get.summary: Daily rate board with trend arrows
get.description: Median rate per kg for every active category with a ±3% trend (`UP` / `DOWN` / `FLAT`) vs the previous week.

post.summary: Instant value estimate with ±10% band

get.description: Expanding radius (5→10→25→50 km) until ≥3 candidates; scored out of 100 (rate 40, distance 30, pickup 10, rating 10, freshness 10).
Pass both `latitude` and `longitude` to filter by `radiusKm` and sort by distance; otherwise returns all points.

get.summary: Anonymised public receipt by share token

post.summary: Create a DRAFT lot valued at today's price
post.description: Step 1 of the lot flow. The lot is priced from the admin-set rate (`GET /api/v1/prices/today`); creation fails with `PRICE_NOT_SET` if the admin has not set one, and `LOCATION_REQUIRED` if no coordinates are given. Next step: `POST /api/v1/lots/{id}/confirm`.

latitude.description: Used to find recyclers within 5 km

photos.description: Storage keys obtained from /uploads/presign (validated against the caller)

get.description: Collectors may only read their own lots; `ADMIN` can read any lot.

delete.summary: Delete a lot and its dependent rows
delete.description: Owner collector or `ADMIN`. Rejected with `INVALID_STATE` once the lot is `HANDED_OVER` or `COMPLETED`.

post.summary: RETIRED — always returns 410
post.description: Collectors no longer pick a recycler directly. Use `POST /api/v1/lots/{id}/confirm`, then `GET /api/v1/lots/{id}/offers` and `POST /api/v1/lots/{id}/select`.

get.description: Only participants of the lot's transaction (owner collector, matched recycler staff) or `ADMIN`. `callerRole`, `canAccept` and `canCounter` are computed for the caller.

post.summary: Submit an offer / counter-offer
post.description: Provide `offerRatePaise` or `offerRateRupees`. Notifies the other party. Not allowed once the transaction is `PAID` or `CANCELLED`.

schema.description: At least one of offerRatePaise / offerRateRupees is required

example.note: Can meet at ₹48/kg if delivered before 4 PM

post.summary: Accept the other party's pending offer
post.description: Locks `agreedRatePaise`, recomputes the price and notifies the other party. A party cannot accept its own offer (`ADMIN` may accept either).

get.description: Visible to the lot's collector, the chosen recycler and admins (404 for anyone else). Never returns the 4-digit code or its hash: the code lives only on the collector's phone.

post.summary: Request a doorstep pickup (expires in 24 h)
Record unserviced-area demand
Push offline mutations (outbox)
post.description: Up to 100 mutations; parents are applied first. Each item is validated on its own (a malformed one is a per-item `REJECTED / INVALID_PAYLOAD`). Results come back in request order, each with `clientMutationId`, `status` (`APPLIED`, `DUPLICATE` only for a repeat of an applied mutation, `CONFLICT`, `REJECTED`), `code`, `message`, `retryable`. `REJECTED` + `retryable:true` is not remembered, so the same mutation can be resent. Contract: docs/sync-contract.md.

get.summary: Pull server-side changes since a cursor
get.description: Lots, notifications and pickup requests changed after `since`, paged as one stream (at most `limit` items in total, default 200, max 500). `since` is an ISO time or a `nextSince` value returned earlier (opaque; send it back unchanged). Loop while `hasMore`. `lotUpdates` announces server-decided lot states (`CONFIRMED`, `PAID`, `REJECTED`, `DISPUTED`) in the client vocabulary. Contract: docs/sync-contract.md §4.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time, or `nextSince` from the previous pull

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per response across all collections

post.summary: Get an upload URL + storage key
post.description: Returned `storageKey` is prefixed `images/{userId}/` and must be used in lot `photos` / `lot_image` mutations.

put.summary: Upload raw bytes to local storage (dev driver)
put.description: Target of the `uploadUrl` returned by `/uploads/presign` when `STORAGE_DRIVER=local`. ⚠ No authentication is enforced by this route.

post.summary: Mark all my notifications as read
Mark one notification as read
post.description: Also available as `PATCH`. Only the owner (or `ADMIN`) may mark it read.

patch.summary: Mark one notification as read (PATCH alias)

get.summary: Admin-set price for today, per material
get.description: `ratePerKgPaise` is `null` when the admin has not set a price; such materials cannot be listed.

post.summary: Confirm a DRAFT lot and broadcast it to recyclers within 5 km
post.description: Lot becomes `READY`. Notified recyclers see material, weight, price, distance and area — never the collector's name or phone.

409.description: Lot is not in DRAFT state (`INVALID_STATE`)

get.summary: Recyclers ready to buy this lot (poll while READY)
get.description: Returns only `INTERESTED` / `SELECTED` offers, plus broadcast counters.

post.summary: Re-run the 5 km broadcast for a READY lot
post.description: Notifies only recyclers that were not notified before.

post.summary: Sell the lot to one INTERESTED recycler
post.description: Both sides can then see each other's details. Returns the deal with its payment link.

get.summary: Full deal view (both parties, amount, payment link)
get.description: Only the lot's collector, the selected recycler or an admin; otherwise `NOT_FOUND`. `NO_DEAL` (404) until a recycler has been selected.

post.summary: DEMO payment: mark the deal PAID from the scanned QR token
post.description: No real money moves. The QR encodes `{origin}/pay/{token}`; the app takes the token and calls this. Calling it again is safe and returns the same paid deal.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Payment token from the deal's `paymentToken` / QR

409.description: Lot cannot be paid in its current state (`NOT_PAYABLE`)

post.summary: Recycler staff / admin sign-in with phone + password
post.description: Collectors use `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with a PIN. Locked for 15 minutes after repeated failures.

bearerAuth.description: Mobile JWT returned by `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (or register / pin-recovery / restore-on-new-phone). Valid for 30 days. The token carries the user's `role`.

cookieAuth.name: ewaste_session
cookieAuth.description: httpOnly web-portal session cookie (7 days) set when a Recycler / Admin / Field Agent / Collector signs in on the web portal.

details.description: Optional extra context (e.g. zod error tree)

Lot.description: Lot row with related category / images / transaction / handovers / payments (relations vary per endpoint).

listedRatePerKgPaise.description: Admin's today's price at lot creation

DealView.description: Full deal after the collector selected a recycler. Visible to the lot's collector, the selected recycler and admins.

payUrl.description: DEMO: opening/scanning this marks the deal paid

clientMutationId.description: Idempotency key (UUID v4), reused unchanged on every retry

op.description: Which ops an entity allows: docs/sync-contract.md §7

retryable.description: Only `REJECTED` may be true; such an outcome is not remembered and can be resent
